title: Sunflower Fighter Poses
description: A 2x4 grid of illustrations showing a young female character in a yellow sunflower-themed outfit performing dynamic combat poses against a solid green background. The top row includes a full standing pose, a running punch, a close-up of a powerful sunflower energy blast from her fist, and a large sunflower with black feathers.
prompt: A character sheet of a young anime girl with short black hair and goggles, wearing a yellow sunflower-patterned jacket, shorts, and boots with black belts and straps. She has a sunflower on her head and is shown in multiple dynamic fighting poses throwing yellow energy blasts, standing confidently, and running. One panel shows a close-up of her fist releasing a massive sunflower explosion. Bright green background, vibrant comic book style with bold black outlines.
